concept: Kinesis Data Streams: real-time stream with ordering and replay
tests: Choosing a service for millions of events/sec with multiple consumers, per-key ordering and re-reading.
expected: Kinesis Data Streams: shards, ordering by partition key, retention → replay, multiple consumers. Triggers: "clickstream", "real time", "multiple consumers", "ordering per key", "replay".
why_not: SQS standard — no ordering or replay; SNS — pub/sub without storage; Batch — batch computing.
